A comprehensive summary for our work would be that
we provide the first deep regression-based monocular camera-based global localization approach that outperforms CNNbased place recognition approaches in outdoor environments.
our approach is able to localize a robot at 1 m accuracy in outdoor scenarios using a single monocular camera.
our approach provides a simple, fast, and accurate solution to the challenging problem of global localization in outdoor scenarios using a single camera.
The main takeaway from our work is that
a deep regression-based approach is more robust than a place recognition-based approach for monocular camera localization.
CNNs can directly regress 6-Do F pose without the need for a hand-engineered feature extractor or a pose estimator.
deep regression of 6-DoFs can outperform traditional visual metric localization methods in terms of accuracy and time complexity.
